projectDescriptions.cphNg: Compile, run, and judge competitive-programming problems in VS Code with downloaded samples, local problems, special judging, stress tests, and multi-platform submission.
projectDescriptions.xmojScript: A browser userscript that improves problem solving, discussions, and everyday use on XMOJ. It is now maintained by XMOJ-Script-dev, with the early personal version still available separately.
projectDescriptions.oj: An online judge server I contributed to, built with C++ and MySQL and improved around resource management, memory safety, and frontend modernization.
projectDescriptions.hydroHelper: A VS Code helper extension built for Hydro users to retrieve problems, manage code, and connect Hydro with a local competitive-programming workflow.
projectDescriptions.shanghaiTextbook: A structured search and download service for Shanghai school textbooks, workbooks, and related learning resources.
projectDescriptions.miniapp: A native mini app for the Youdao Dictionary Pen, involving device integration, C++, and embedded constraints.
projectDescriptions.luoguCaptcha: A machine-learning model and inference implementation for recognizing Luogu captchas.
projectDescriptions.math: A discontinued mathematics solver whose source remains available for reference.
